notes:
Summary: Mid-market product team shipping search within a B2B SaaS product. Primary goal: improve result ordering with a reranking endpoint without blowing up latency or tokens. Approaching Redwood with a two-step migration: test Hosted API for rapid iteration, then move to Dedicated for predictable P50/P95 once model & config stabilized.

POC scope (agreed):
- Offline rerank scoring harness: run batch scoring on 10k queries x 50k candidates, compute NDCG@10, MRR; Redwood Optimize suggestions expected for quantization/kernel recommendations.
- Live A/B via client-side feature flag: 10% traffic to Redwood hosted rerank for 2 weeks, fallback to in-house ranker on errors.
- Instrument eval set + prompt templates; want ability to run offline rescoring in our infra with Redwood model artifacts or via dedicated endpoint.

Performance targets and constraints:
- Latency: end-to-end rerank latency budget 120ms P95 for top-50 rerank window (client will accept higher if batched async).
- Throughput: peak 150 qps during business hours; cost sensitivity for token-based hosted billing -> looking for batching and prefix caching to reduce unit costs.

Security / compliance:
- Require SSO (SAML) for console access, SOC2 evidence for Dedicated contract, audit logs with 1y retention, KMS for key control. Data residency preference: NA cloud regions.

Stakeholders / quotes:
- Head of Product (R. Sanchez): "We need measurable uplift on NDCG before committing to Dedicated."
- Lead ML Eng (T. Nguyen): cares about offline scoring reproducibility and ability to run evals deterministically.
- Procurement: wants a simple committed capacity option with clear overage pricing.

Technical notes / asks for Redwood:
- Can the rerank endpoint accept candidate embeddings + context and return scores only (not full re-gen)? Client prefers score-only to save tokens.
- Offline scoring: need SDK or batch runner example to re-score large dumps (50M rows later).
- Eval automation: integrate Redwood Optimize eval hooks so alerts trigger when NDCG regresses >3% on anchor set.

Next steps:
- Redwood to send Dedicated pricing sheet and sample contract addendum for SOC2 evidence (drive link).
- SE (Liam) to provide score-only rerank example and batching config recommendations by 2025-03-04.
- Helix to complete security questionnaire and provide lambda access pattern for A/B integration.

Notes style: shorthand, action-focused. Keep following up on latency SLO confirmation and procurement timeline.
